overview_description.description:
Summer Playbook is an online community of young people around the world who want to get offline and hang out in person. Its main focus is to let its users see what people around them are doing so they can join them offline.

Playbook is focused on college campuses.

Playbook was founded by Luke Heine, Raphael Rouvinov, and Sean Sullivan.
